item.title: Loving this SCP
item.content:encoded: This one has quickly become one of my favorites. The behavior of this infection and the infected individuals makes me think of the Zerg from the StarCraft videogames crossed with grotesque mushroom zombies from The Last of Us.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
That's exactly why I think SCP-093 is my favorite. The SCP on it's own is quite interesting, but those color tests make it a universe all its own!
Thanks for the reminder on SCP-002. The Foundation sure loves their fleshy abominations. With an evolution from bettering "itself" to "terra-forming for its spread," this could definitely be a sequel or "crashed later" version of 002.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Ok there HAS to be inspiration from 002 in this one. Surprised nobody else (of the other two people here) has commented on that.
Creepy af, but different from your average 'zombie' infection.
The extra work put into adding the reports really help to paint out the SCP, one of the reasons I very much enjoyed 093.
I have previously been scared away by the grotesque image(ry), but these stories really keep me wanting to read…
+1 for main and -L
